title: PID Closed-Loop Steering as a Beginner-Accessible Control Experiment

original_idea.body: Implement minimal closed-loop P/PI/PID steerer on a small open model and ablate each term. Inference-only, single GPU.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: more robust closed-loop steering reduces over-steering harm, but the catastrophic-risk link is indirect (level 3).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Implementing a closed-loop PID steerer with layer hooks needs solid engineering; mentor-guided novice feasible (level 4).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (P/PI/PID ablation), implementing the controller adds modest workstream (level 4).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly accessible reproduction of PID steering on open models (level 4).

novelty.reasoning: PID steering already published; this is an accessible reproduction.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: PID steering is published; the contribution is an accessible reproduction/ablation.
